description: The desktop window's permission list, and no origin. Tauri decides an IPC call against the CALLER'S ORIGIN, and this window's origin is its own embedded server (#312) — which Tauri treats as REMOTE, so the machine transport and the rest are granted to it only if a capability names that URL. That URL is not knowable at build time: the port comes from --port or the settings file, and the host is loopback unless --host/--bind-all asked for a LAN address. lib.rs therefore adds a second capability carrying THIS list for the address the server bound (#389). This entry is deliberately instanced for no origin — no `remote`, and `local: false` — and is kept because tauri-build is what resolves and checks every identifier below; deleting it would take the list's only build-time check with it, and leave a build that trims unused commands (build.removeUnusedCommands) with no reason to keep the machine commands at all.
